ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Trump Administration's Investigations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's investigations, including the one into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell.
questions: What are the allegations against Jerome Powell?
How does this investigation affect the Federal Reserve?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the Trump administration's actions. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption.
